work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Motu proprio CCVIII withdraws the pious house of the Holy Cross in via della Lungara from the college of Roman parish priests and commits its administration to the Good Shepherd sisters under the cardinal vicar; LF44262 → LF44268 across running title LF44265; LF44326 → LF44335 across own provenance LF44329 and running title LF44332; LF44396 → LF44402 across page number 303 LF44399; complete 11 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF44223–44223; the source closing at LF44416–44419 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima prima maii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontifi- catus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
